text: I can pick maxSurge and maxUnavailable for a rolling deploy and calculate its duration and extra capacity.
I can explain why a missing readiness probe turns a rolling deploy into an error spike.
I can calculate a canary's blast radius and judge whether its traffic is enough to detect a given error-rate regression.
I can choose between rolling, blue-green and canary for a service and state what each costs.
I can name the four feature toggle categories and set lifetimes and owners to avoid flag debt.
I can write the expand/contract steps for renaming a column so every deploy and rollback stays safe.
